description: Qty lines (unit price on a second line, line total on the right), a discount line, and an ALV (VAT) summary block. Prices include VAT, so tax must be 0/null. The ALV block, YHTEENSÄ and KORTTI lines must NOT become items.
note: Item lines sum to 6750; receipt total is 6550 after the discount. The contract has no discount field and parseReceipt skips negative prices, so the expected app result is the 5 items (sum 6750) and the 2,00 discount is lost unless handled.
